capabilities: Open and read .cbz files directly from the File Explorer
Lazily load and unload page images to limit memory use
Navigate pages via a canvas-thumbnail minimap with drag and click-to-jump
Copy comic images to the clipboard from a context menu
extras: The manifest carries the warning "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff." The README requests donations and includes manual installation steps, indicating it may not yet be in the Community Plugin directory.
problem: Obsidian cannot open .cbz comic book archives, so reading stored comics requires extracting files or switching to an external application.
summary: CBZ comic archive reader that opens .cbz files from the vault and displays their pages with lazy loading and a minimap scrollbar.
